title: Sizzle 'n' Slurp Sweet Chilli Tofu Noodles
subtitle: with Pak Choy and Peanuts
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Thinly slice the onion. Thickly slice the pak choy stems, leaving the leaves whole. Thinly slice the tofu. Combine the kecap manis, Chinese barbecue seasoning, 1 tsp white vinegar and 2 tbs water in a bowl.
Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 9 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.
Warm tofu: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan.

Toss tofu and noodles: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the pak choy stems and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until tender. Stir in the kecap manis mixture, tofu and noodles and cook for 1 min or until the noodles are coated. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Add the pak choy leaves to the noodle mixture and toss to combine. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the tofu noodles among bowls. Scatter over the peanuts and enjoy!
Make it spicy: If you like a kick of heat, scatter over a pinch of chilli flakes or thinly sliced fresh chilli just before serving.
